target_customer: Founders, SDRs and lean sales teams doing outbound prospecting
problem: Sales reps spend days researching leads across many data sources; Persana combined enrichment from many providers, buying-intent signals and AI-written outreach in one tool.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with credits (starter plan around $85 per month per a 2026 review)
product_category: AI sales prospecting and data enrichment

founders.name: Sriya Maram
founders.background_notes: Product manager on customer data at LinkedIn per YC page.

founders.name: Rush Shahani
founders.background_notes: AI engineer with about five years of NLP work per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly integrations with data providers, workflow automation and LLM-written messages; no research-grade component.

defensibility.rationale: Waterfall enrichment and AI personalization were copyable and Clay, Apollo and ZoomInfo competed directly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Press in 2024 positioned Persana against Apollo, ZoomInfo and Clay. Rox acquired the team in April 2026 and the standalone product was shut down on May 2, 2026.

market_need_then: Outbound sales teams relied on manual research and multiple data tools; LinkedIn alumni founders saw the pain firsthand. Quantified demand at founding was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: High energy and promotional: Your Revenue Machine, on autopilot, vibe GTM

branding.brand_signature: Positioning as a cheaper all-in-one alternative to Clay
branding.community_and_virality: Two Product Hunt launches (April 2024 and January 2025), a Forbes mention and a 4.8 G2 rating claimed on the company site.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive invented name with launch coverage and community listings, but the brand stayed a Clay challenger and was retired on acquisition.

pivots.to: AI sales agents including voice agents
pivots.why: Product Hunt launch of sales and voice agents in January 2025; reason not stated.

outcome_analysis: Persana was a two person LinkedIn-alum team that shipped an AI prospecting tool in the Winter 2023 batch and raised a $2.3M seed in October 2024 after Product Hunt launches. It competed against Clay, Apollo and ZoomInfo with a cheaper all-in-one pitch, then pivoted toward agents. Rox acquired the team in April 2026 and the standalone product closed, which suggests a team acquisition rather than a breakout. The price is undisclosed and the competition factor is an inference.
notes: Seed of $2.3M corroborated by IT Brief and other outlets and Seedtable; investor check sizes not disclosed. One aggregator lists an extra $500K pre-seed in April 2023, unverified and not recorded. Acquisition date April 2026 and the May 2, 2026 shutdown come from a research write-up and Persana and Rox announcements. Competitor coverage found was dated 2024 or later (Clay, Apollo, ZoomInfo), after the Winter 2023 batch, so the dated list is empty. The failure factor is an inference.
